fusions.name: Circling Lunge
fusions.desc: You rush the target and bite for 12 damage, make it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and leave it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Taste of Blood
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A cone of spray that deals 9 damage to everything caught in it, heals you for 20% of the damage dealt and has a 30% chance to leave targets [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Scent of Weakness
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you heal for 15% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
